task.pr_title: Removed usage of deprecated v1 Bitstamp API

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Why was this rounding to 5 decimal places added? Is there some significant figure requirement with the new API? I am not seeing this in the new Bitstamp API documentation at first glance.

evidence.thread_resolution:
tommq: That does look incorrect. I removed setting scale and tested it by withdrawing LTC with 8 decimals. It worked fine.
jtrimmer-nydig: Super, thanks! Tested with BTC too.
